sources.source_name: Yale Appliance — JennAir Column Service Rate Trend
sources.snippet: JennAir column service rate improved dramatically: 36.7% (2021) to 15.8% (2022). Dropped from Yale tracking after improvement trend. Whirlpool platform with variable-speed inverter compressor — genuine differentiator within the Whirlpool portfolio. Compressor start device W10448874 cross-compatible across entire Whirlpool portfolio including KitchenAid.
sources.classification_reason: Pool S with quantified service rate trend data and platform identification.

sources.source_name: Consumer Reports — JennAir Column Refrigerator Tests
sources.snippet: JennAir column models test well for temperature uniformity. Active humidity zones in crisper drawers. No air purification system. Noise in 39-42 dBA range. Temperature precision approximately ±1°F. Modular ice maker design (removable, not integrated).
sources.classification_reason: Pool A independent testing with quantified metrics.

sources.snippet: 1-year full warranty (parts and labor). 12-year sealed system warranty (compressor, evaporator, condenser). This sealed system coverage matches Sub-Zero and is the longest in the Whirlpool portfolio. Column-specific warranty confirmed — not affected by French door model issues.
sources.classification_reason: Verified warranty terms — manufacturer-confirmed. CORRECTED in v2 from 5-10yr to 12yr sealed system.

sources.source_name: JennAir Class Action — Evaporator Defect (French Door Only)
sources.snippet: Class action lawsuit filed regarding evaporator freezing defect affecting JennAir French door refrigerator models. Column models are NOT included in the class action — the defect is specific to French door air circulation design. Column models use different evaporator configuration.
sources.classification_reason: Lawsuit = report only per Rule 1. Additionally, confirmed NOT applicable to scored column models.

sources.snippet: Obsidian stainless steel interior is distinctive. Variable-speed inverter compressor is a genuine engineering differentiator vs other Whirlpool-platform products. Single compressor with dual evaporator configuration — not dual independent like BSH/Sub-Zero. Whirlpool authorized service network is broad and accessible.
sources.classification_reason: Pool A with specific architecture and component analysis.

sources.source_name: r/appliancerepair — JennAir Column vs French Door
sources.snippet: Multiple technicians confirm column models are structurally different from French door models — different evaporator layout, different air circulation. Evaporator freezing issue is French door specific. Column reliability has been significantly better. Parts availability is good through Whirlpool network. 10-14 year parts horizon.
sources.classification_reason: Pool B with 3+ technician confirmations distinguishing column from French door issues.

sources.snippet: JennAir is the premium brand in Whirlpool's portfolio. Variable-speed inverter compressor is the one genuine technical differentiator. Cyclopentane PU insulation is industry standard. Standard magnetic door seals. Multi-source manufacturing through Whirlpool global supply chain.
sources.classification_reason: Pool B with platform and construction analysis.

sources.snippet: Owners report mixed initial experiences but improving trend in recent model years. Several note the Obsidian interior is premium quality. Modular ice maker praised — easy to remove/replace if issues arise. Consensus emerging that column models are significantly more reliable than JennAir French door models.
sources.classification_reason: Pool C with emerging owner consensus on column-specific reliability.

sources.snippet: Whirlpool sold JennAir to Electrolux as part of broader portfolio restructuring (2025). Integration is ongoing. Service and warranty continuity during transition is uncertain. Long-term brand direction under Electrolux TBD.
sources.classification_reason: Corporate outlook — report only per Rule 15. Acquisition creates uncertainty.

bottom_line: JennAir Column is the best product on the Whirlpool platform for built-in refrigeration. Variable-speed inverter compressor is a genuine differentiator. Obsidian stainless interior. The critical v2 correction: sealed system warranty is 12 years (matching Sub-Zero) and the class action evaporator defect does NOT apply to column models. Service rate improved dramatically (36.7% to 15.8%). Still on Whirlpool's shared platform with cross-compatible components. Corporate outlook is Conditional due to Electrolux acquisition creating transition uncertainty.
v2_notes: Two corrections: (1) class action confirmed N/A to column models, (2) sealed system warranty confirmed 12yr not 5-10yr. v1 66 → v2 70.
platform_disclosure: Whirlpool/JennAir: JennAir shares Whirlpool compressor platform. Start device W10448874 cross-applies across entire Whirlpool portfolio including KitchenAid.
outlook_rationale: Whirlpool sold JennAir to Electrolux (2025). Integration uncertainty. Service rate improvement trend is real but short track record at column-specific level.
